intro.text: One of Governor Replar Innate's guardsmen, who tries to shoot the governor during a speech.

items.text: As the governor finished a speech defending his murdered brother, Rian shuffled and muttered in pain, then raised his revolver at him. Only Marasi saw it; she tackled Rian inside a cadmium bubble, slowing time so the other guards could rush the governor away and seize Rian.

Held in a cell built for Metalborn, Rian would only mumble, and Marasi talked Reddi and Caberel out of beating him or threatening his daughter. Wax found his metalminds were fakes, and Rian confessed that Bleeder had forced him to make the attempt on the governor and meant to strike again. At Rian's word, Wax cut a coin carrying a message out of his forearm. The constables also found a Hemalurgic spike in his body.

appearance.text: He wears the dark suit and hat of the governor's guards.

personality.text: Since Bleeder meddled with his mind he seems mad: he mutters, rocks back and forth, hums at random and only half follows what is going on around him.
